defensiveAbilities.name: Glow
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A will-o'-wisp is itself naturally invisible, but glows with a colored light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.

defensiveAbilities.name: Magic Immunity
defensiveAbilities.description: A will-o'-wisp is immune to all spells except Faerie Fire, Revealing Light, Force Barrage, and Quandary.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feed on Magic
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement A creature who can cast spells is within 15 feet of the spellvoid

Effect The spellvoid feeds on the creature's magic. The spellvoid regains 2d8 Healing Damage Hit Points, and the target must attempt a DC 24 Will Saving Throw save.

The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The first time the target Casts a Spell before the start of the spellvoid's next turn, the spell is disrupted unless the target succeeds at a DC 15 Flat check.

Failure As success, but the effect applies the first time the target Casts a Spell within the next minute.

Critical Failure As success, but the effect applies each time the target Casts a Spell within the next minute. In addition, the spellvoid doubles the Hit Points it regains.

offensiveAbilities.name: Go Dark
offensiveAbilities.description: The will-o'-wisp extinguishes its glow, becoming Invisible. It can end this effect with another use of this action. If it uses its shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine its location, making the will-o'-wisp only Hidden to all observers until it moves.
